newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Arianespace to launch Indonesian satellite.
newsitem.headline: Arianespace to launch Indonesian satellite.

text.p: Indonesia's Telecommuncations Corporation and Europe's Arianespace signed a contract on Monday for the launch of a new Indonesian satellite in late 1998 or early 1999.

The 2,500-kg Telkom 1 satellite, built by Lockheed Martin Communications Inc, a unit of Lockheed Martin Corp, will be launched from the European space port in French Guyana, Arianespace said in a statement.
Arianespace launched Indonesia's Palapa-C2 satellite in May 1996 and will launch the country's Indostar satellite later this year.
The Telkom 1 satellite, owned by PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom), will be equipped with 36 C Band transponders.
"This new satellite will enable PT Telkom to offer voice and data telecommunications services for more than 15 years," the Arianespace statement said.
Telkom is also listed in New York and in London.
